(Japanese: '''最高潮！決戦前夜サトシVSダンデ！！''' ''Climax! The Night Before the Decisive Battle! {{tt|Satoshi|Ash}} VS {{tt|Dande|Leon}}!!'') is the 128th episode of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', and the 1,213th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on October 14, 2022.
{{spoilers}}

==Plot==
The "[[World Coronation Series|Pokémon World Coronation Series]] News" makes a broadcast before the finals of the [[Masters Eight Tournament]], with Mr. {{tt|Daimonji|Fire Blast}}, a battle reviewer, acting as a special guest. After a brief recap of the Masters Eight and the results of the quarterfinals, the semifinals matches of {{an|Leon}} versus [[Diantha]] and {{Ash}} versus {{an|Cynthia}} are given more detailed recaps, accompanied by commentary from Mr. Daimonji, who analyzes on the strategies used in each match.

With the final match of Ash versus Leon having been set up, both of their full [[Party|teams]] are introduced, including the three Pokémon that Leon hasn't yet used in the tournament: {{p|Cinderace}}, {{p|Inteleon}}, and {{p|Mr. Rime}}. The [[clip show]] concludes with a recap of [[JN013|Ash and Leon's first, unofficial battle]], which ended with them promising each other to have an official battle later, a promise that is now about to be fulfilled.

==Trivia==
[[File:JN128 AS.png|thumb|150px|The "[[After the Story]]" artwork for this episode]]
* Mr. Daimonji reads the [[title card]] for this episode.
* This is the last episode to be left undubbed for {{aniseries|PTS}}.
* [[James]], {{MTR}}, [[Jessie]], and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} narrate the preview for the [[JN129|next episode]].
** A special preview regarding the final match of the [[Masters Eight Tournament]], {{Ash}} versus {{an|Leon}}, was aired after the episode.
* As a [[clip show]], this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan and South Korea.
